Question: There exists a unique strictly increasing sequence of nonnegative integers \(a_1 \lt a_2 \lt \cdots \lt a_k\) such that \[\frac{2^{289} + 1}{2^{17} + 1} = 2^{a_1} + 2^{a_2} + \cdots + 2^{a_k}.\] What is \(k?\)
